payload.summary: assumption: the deterministic-engine/LLM-narrator split (ADR-0001) is the right reading of 'acts like a game master'. The paragraph could be read as the LLM holding game authority. I chose the split because a hallucinated refutation silently destroys a deduction puzzle and makes the game untestable. This is the single most consequential elaborated constraint — if the human wants a fully LLM-adjudicated game, hard constraint 4 must be amended by them.
